title: The Last Horizon Again
author: Zephyrine Galloway
blurb: Coral Zhou, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
